name: Rend Magic
text:
You spew forth pure magical energy down your arm before releasing it in a devastating attack. Make a melee spell attack against the target's AC. If it hits, the target takes 3d10 force damage, then takes ceil(@item.rank/2-1)d10 force damage each time it Casts a Spell for 1 minute; on a critical hit, double the initial damage and the damage when the target casts spells. This spell ends immediately if the target ends its turn without Casting a Spell.

---
Heightened (+2) The initial force damage increases by 2d10, and the force damage taken whenever the target casts a spell increases by 1d10.
